title: Inter-VLAN Routing (Router on a Stick)
description: Understand how subinterfaces route between VLANs.
scenario: Understand how subinterfaces route between VLANs.

concepts.title: Inter-VLAN Routing
concepts.body: Devices in different VLANs cannot communicate without a Layer 3 device. A router with subinterfaces can route between them.
concepts.code:
VLAN 10 → 192.168.10.0/24
VLAN 20 → 192.168.20.0/24
Router routes between them

concepts.title: Router on a Stick
concepts.body: One physical router link carries multiple VLANs using subinterfaces with 802.1Q encapsulation.
concepts.code:
Gi0/0.10 → VLAN 10
Gi0/0.20 → VLAN 20
encapsulation dot1Q 10

concepts.title: Layer 3 Switch Alternative
concepts.body: Layer 3 switches use SVIs (interface vlan) for routing — faster than router-on-a-stick.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface vlan 10
SW1(config-if)# ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0
